statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains well below the block threshold on an orderly two-sided overnight path, while Stress is elevated ahead of a clustered 12:30 UTC data block and an after-close AI catalyst.
recommendation: Observed conditions are consistent with normal mean-reverting Nasdaq-100 structure. The 12:30 UTC release cluster, the 13:30 UTC cash open and the after-close NVIDIA report are the evidence-based checkpoints at which the mapped state may change; the assessment is refreshed hourly.
headline: Orderly two-sided NQ band and a 15.6 VIX keep Tail low into the 12:30 UTC data cluster
body: NQ futures trade near 29,258, about -0.1%, in the upper half of a two-sided 29,096-29,310 overnight band that has been rejected in both directions, following the Nasdaq-100 cash close at 29,209.23 (+0.64%). VIX is 15.62 in a narrow 15.62-15.74 range, WTI is near $80.28 after a 2.5% third consecutive decline on Iran-Oman Strait of Hormuz corridor diplomacy, and Treasury yields are steady with the 2Y at 4.24%, the 10Y at 4.70% and the 30Y at 5.23% on the latest H.15 observation. There is no observed directional efficiency, no session-extreme holding and no chain of shallow pullbacks, so Tail stays in the low band and the mapped policy state is EA_ON. Stress is elevated because the scheduled stack is dense and clustered: Core PCE, the Q2 GDP second estimate, durable goods and personal income all print together at 12:30 UTC, one hour before the 13:30 UTC cash open, and NVIDIA reports after the 20:00 UTC close as the Jackson Hole symposium opens. Delayed cross-asset context is aligned but unremarkable, with megacaps mixed-positive, semiconductors higher in 6 of 7 names, Treasury futures flat and application software the one clearly weak latest-session group. The danger window is kept narrow around the release cluster and the first cash half-hour rather than extended across the whole session, and conditional Tail returns to the watch band later for the after-close report, where a delayed second leg through guidance is the specific structural concern.

lookbackSummary: The 24 previously published hours describe a steady de-escalation from Tuesday's European session, where Tail sat at 20-21 in the watch band with a trend-up mode, into a calm overnight regime. Tail fell through the Tuesday US cash session to 9-12 and has held at 11 for the whole overnight window with a normal dominant mode, so the mapped state has been EA_ON continuously since 14:00 UTC on 25 August. Stress drifted from the mid-40s to the mid-50s as the Wednesday event stack approached, while Confidence held at 87-88 throughout.
outlookSummary: The horizon is defined by two scheduled binary checkpoints rather than by any observed trend. Conditional Tail rises into the watch band for the clustered 12:30 UTC release and the 13:30 UTC cash open, decays through the midday and early afternoon as the reaction matures, then returns to the top of the watch band for the 20:00-22:00 UTC NVIDIA release and guidance call, where a delayed second leg in thinner post-close liquidity is the structural concern. From late evening onward conditional Tail decays back to the low-band baseline as the binaries resolve and Asian then European hours favour range formation. Confidence is modelled lower at the far end of the horizon because that evidence is scheduled-calendar structure rather than price path. The Warsh Jackson Hole keynote on Friday at 14:00 UTC, alongside the preliminary payrolls benchmark revision at the same instant, is the next high-impact checkpoint beyond this window.
